messages:
alex: Heads-up — we've been getting noisy alerts from embed-service cache TTL causing p95 inference latency spikes this morning. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/embed-service-latency?orgId=1&from=now-2h&to=now. Can we consider a short mute window or adjust threshold?

mira: Saw that too. Spikes align with the nightly batch job at ~08:15 PST. Kibana snippet: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/doc/xyz. Could we silence during 08:10-08:25? :thinking: 

sam: Quick data check — current rule is p95 > 200ms for 5m. If this is the batch causing it, a temporary snooze makes sense. Prefer a scheduled silence over permanently bumping thresholds.

olivia: I agree with a scheduled silence, but would prefer changing the alert severity to `warning` during the window rather than full mute so we still have visibility in aggregates. Also add a runbook link.

mira: +1 to tagging the alerts as `scheduled-batch` so we can filter them later. If we increase threshold we might miss real regressions outside the window.

alex: OK — plan: create a 30m scheduled silence 08:00-08:30 PST, tag alerts as `scheduled-batch`, and add a runbook annotation. If anything looks wrong after the batch, ping @mira and we roll back.

sam: I'll open the PR to add a snooze schedule and the tag. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/observability/pull/642 (will update). Example rule patch I'm proposing:

```
- alert: EmbedServiceHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/embed-p95
    note: "scheduled-batch"
  schedules:
    - when: "08:00-08:30 PST"
      action: snooze
```

oncall-bot: Scheduled silence created — EmbedServiceHighP95 — 08:00-08:30 PST — created by sam. ID: SNOOZE-9876.

olivia: LGTM. I'll post a short note in #incidents explaining the batch and the temporary silence.

alex: Thanks all — I'll watch the Grafana dash during and after the job. If we see spikes outside the window we should reconvene and consider an autoscaling tweak or a more targeted metric.
